title: Customer Care Guidance on Fee Reversals for Larkspur Credit Cards
content:
This guidance sets out when a fee on any of the Larkspur Credit Cards is reversed, and under which reason.

## The rule

A fee may be reversed once.

A courtesy reversal of a late or returned-payment fee is granted on request when fewer than the card's courtesy reversals per 12 months have been granted on the account.

Fees posted through a Larkspur error are reversed as lender error. A second penalty fee for a single event is reversed as single penalty event. Fees tied to a billing error resolved in the cardholder's favor are reversed as dispute resolved. These three reasons have no count limits.

Annual fees are not reversed as a courtesy.

## Reasons at a glance

| Reason | Covers | Count limit |
|---|---|---|
| Courtesy | A late fee or a returned-payment fee, on request | Fewer than the card's courtesy reversals per 12 months must have been granted on the account |
| Lender error | Fees posted through a Larkspur error | None |
| Single penalty event | A second penalty fee for a single event | None |
| Dispute resolved | Fees tied to a billing error resolved in the cardholder's favor | None |

Whatever the reason, each fee is reversed at most once. A fee that already has a reversal entry tied to it is not reversed again.

## Counting courtesy reversals

- **The window** is the rolling 12 months ending today: today and the 364 days before it.
- **The count** is the number of fee reversals on the same card account with the reason courtesy, dated within that window.
- **The comparison** is between that count and the card's courtesy reversal allowance. A courtesy reversal is granted when the count is fewer than the allowance.

Both are read from the account's posted entries before the reversal.

## Hypothetical cases

The allowance and dates below are invented for illustration.

- **Allowance of 1, no courtesy reversal in the window.** The count is 0, which is fewer than 1, so a courtesy reversal of a late fee is granted on request.
- **Allowance of 1, a courtesy reversal dated exactly 364 days before today.** That reversal is inside the window, so the count is 1. One is not fewer than 1, so the condition for a courtesy reversal is not met.
- **Allowance of 1, the only courtesy reversal dated 365 days before today.** That reversal is outside the window, so the count is 0 and the courtesy reversal is granted.
- **An annual fee.** It is not reversed as a courtesy, whatever the count.
- **A late fee the company posted in error.** It is reversed as lender error, with no count limit, provided that fee has not already been reversed.
